731: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ; ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
O my beloved Lord, I cannot know the limit of Your virtues.
ਤੂੰ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You fill the water, the land and the sky; You Yourself pervade all. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮਨੁ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ. ਚਿਤੁ ਤੁਲਾ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
If the mind were the scale, the consciousness the weight, and Your service the assayer,
ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ. ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਤੋਲੀ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
then within my own heart I would weigh my Husband Lord; in this way I would keep my mind fixed on Him. ॥2॥
ਆਪੇ ਕੰਡਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ; ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
He Himself is the pointer, the weight and the scale; He Himself is the one who weighs.
ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ; ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
He Himself sees, He Himself understands, He Himself is the trader. ॥3॥
ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ; ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
The mind is blind, low-born and a wanderer, coming one moment and going the next.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਹਦਾ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
Nanak lives in its company; how can such a fool find You? ॥4॥2॥9॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ. ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
The one who has worshipped the Lord's Name in the mind through the Word of the Guru
ਸਭਿ ਇਛਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੂਰੀਆ; ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਜਮ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
has every desire of mind and body fulfilled, and all fear of Death is gone. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ॥
O my mind, sing the praises of the Lord's Name.
ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ. ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪੀਆ ਰਸੁ ਗਟਕੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When the Guru is pleased the mind is awakened, and one drinks deep of the Lord's essence. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ; ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ॥
The true congregation of the True Guru is sublime; there one sings the praises of the Lord God.
ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ. ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ; ਹਮ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਗ ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੨॥
O Lord, show mercy and unite me with the true congregation; I will wash the feet of Your servants. ॥2॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ; ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਕੇ ॥
The Lord's Name is the source of every comfort; through the Guru's teaching its essence is tasted with delight.
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ, ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਤਿਸ. ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
The one who has found the amrit, the water of the Lord's Name, is rid of all thirst. ॥3॥
ਹਮਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਤਿ, ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਹਮ ਵੇਚਿਓ ਸਿਰੁ, ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
The True Guru is my caste and my honour; I have sold my head to the Guru.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ; ਗੁਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Servant Nanak: my name has become "the Guru's disciple"; O Guru, save the honour of your servant. ॥4॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ; ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦਾਲਦ ਦਲਘਾ ॥
The one who has meditated on the Name of the Lord, the Supreme Being, has had all poverty destroyed, host upon host.
ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਮੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ; ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਘਾ ॥੧॥
Through the Guru's Word the fear of birth and death is erased; serving the eternal Lord, that one is absorbed in peace. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਰਘਾ ॥
O my mind, meditate on the Lord's most beloved Name.
ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿ ਲੀਓ ਮੁਲਿ ਮਹਘਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have offered my mind and body and placed them before the Guru; I have sold my head for the priceless Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣਹਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਪਕੜਿ ਖੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਲਘਾ ॥
Kings and emperors enjoy pleasures and delights, but without the Name, Death seizes them all and leads them away.
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ਹਥ ਫਲਘਾ ॥੨॥
When the Righteous Judge strikes them on the head and they reap the fruit, then they repent. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ. ਰਾਖੁ. ਜਨ ਕਿਰਮ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ; ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਲਘਾ ॥
O Lord, Sustainer, save us, save us; we are Your humble worms, and have come to Your refuge.
ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਘਾ ॥੩॥
O God, fulfil the longing of Your servant; grant the vision of the saints, that he may find peace. ॥3॥
ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਘਾ ॥
You are the all-powerful Being, the great Lord and Master; give me the gift of Your Name, even for an instant.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਘਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Servant Nanak: the one who receives the Name finds peace; I am ever a sacrifice to the Name. ॥4॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਙੁ ॥
The Lord's Name brings love for the Lord, and that love is fast as the dye of madder.
ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ. ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਾੜਿਆ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਙੁ ॥੧॥
When the Guru is pleased and dyes one in the Lord's love, that colour never fades again. ॥1॥
732: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ॥
O my mind, be dyed in love for the Lord's Name.
ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ. ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰਾਉ ਨਿਸੰਙੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one whom the Guru, when pleased, instructs in the Lord's Name surely meets the Lord, the King. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਅੰਙੁ ॥
The foolish, self-willed bride remains bound to coming and going.
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਮਨਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸਹਲੰਙੁ ॥੨॥
The Lord God does not come to her mind; love of duality is her companion. ॥2॥
ਹਮ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅੰਗੀ ਅੰਙੁ ॥
O Lord, we are full of filth and evil deeds; take our side and protect us.
ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਵਲਾਇਆ; ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪੰਙੁ ॥੩॥
The one whom the Guru bathed in the pool of amrit is rid of all sins and their mire. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਙੁ ॥
O Lord God, merciful to the poorest of the poor, grant me the company of the true congregation.
ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਙੁ ॥੪॥੩॥
Servant Nanak: the one who has found the Lord's love in the congregation keeps that love in mind and body. ॥4॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Those who chant "Lord, Lord" yet keep practising deceit do not become pure in heart.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ; ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
They perform many rituals night and day, but find no peace even in their dreams. ॥1॥
ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
O wise one, without the Guru there is no devotion.
ਕੋਰੈ. ਰੰਗੁ, ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੜੈ; ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Unprepared cloth never takes the dye, however much anyone may want it to. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਪੁ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਵਰਤ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਜਾ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੋਗੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
The self-willed may chant, perform austerities, discipline themselves, fast and worship, but their illness does not go.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੨॥
Within is the great disease of ego; they are ruined by love of duality. ॥2॥
ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ; ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Outwardly they wear religious robes and show much cleverness, but the mind runs in all ten directions.
ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ. ਸਬਦੁ, ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
Gripped by ego, they do not recognise the Word, and come into the womb again and again. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Nanak: the one on whom He casts His glance understands, and meditates on the Name.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ; ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
By the Guru's grace that one knows the One alone and merges in the One. ॥4॥4॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Through the Guru's teaching I searched the city of my body thoroughly,
and found the treasure of the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
The Lord has made peace dwell in my mind.
ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In an instant the fire of desire was quenched; meeting the Guru, all my hunger is gone. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
O my mother, singing the Lord's praises I come alive.
The merciful True Guru has implanted the Lord's virtues and Name in my heart. ॥2॥
ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਢੂਢਿ ਢੂਢਾਈ ॥
I search for my beloved Lord God, and have others help me search.
Joining the true congregation I taste the Lord's essence. ॥3॥
ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖੇ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
The one whose destiny, written from the start, awakens on the forehead finds the Lord;
ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ; ਮੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
Guru Nanak is pleased with that one and unites them with the Lord. ॥4॥1॥5॥
ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
On whom the Lord shows mercy, He fills that mind with love for Him.
Through the Guru that one stays merged in the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
The mind dyed in the Lord's love enjoys bliss.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It stays in joy day and night, absorbed in the Word of the Perfect Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਕਉ. ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Everyone longs for the Lord's love,
but only through the Guru does one take on its deep crimson colour. ॥2॥
The foolish, self-willed person stays undyed;
733: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚੈ; ਰੰਗੁ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
though he longs for it a hundred times, he takes on no colour at all. ॥3॥
When the Lord casts His glance of grace, one finds the True Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
Nanak: then one is absorbed in the essence and the love of the Lord. ॥4॥2॥6॥
The one whose tongue is satisfied with the Lord's essence
drinks it through the Guru and is absorbed in poise. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਜਨ ਚਾਖਹੁ ਜੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
O brothers, if you taste the Lord's essence,
ਤਉ ਕਤ; ਅਨਤ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
how could you be lured by any other taste? ॥1॥ Rahao
Through the Guru's teaching keep this essence enshrined in your heart.
Those steeped in the Lord's essence are dyed in the love of the Lord. ॥2॥
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The self-willed cannot taste the Lord's essence.
They act in ego and receive heavy punishment. ॥3॥
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
When the Lord casts His glance of grace, one receives the Lord's essence.
ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
Nanak: steeped in that essence, one sings the Lord's praises. ॥4॥3॥7॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ; ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Even one of low caste, meditating on the Lord, attains the highest state.
ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬਿਦਰ. ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੈ; ਕਿਸਨੁ ਉਤਰਿਆ. ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Ask about Bidar, son of a maidservant: Krishna went and stayed in his house. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ; ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Listen, O brothers, to the indescribable sermon of the Lord, by which all fear, pain and hunger depart. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਾਰੁ. ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਇਕ ਗਾਇ ॥
Ravidas the leather-worker praised the Lord, singing His praise every moment.
ਪਤਿਤ ਜਾਤਿ. ਉਤਮੁ ਭਇਆ; ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਪਏ ਪਗਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Though of low caste he became exalted, and people of all four castes came and fell at his feet. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮਦੇਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ; ਲੋਕੁ ਛੀਪਾ ਕਹੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
Namdev came to love the Lord, though people called him a calico-printer.
ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ. ਪਿਠਿ ਦੇ ਛੋਡੇ; ਹਰਿ. ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਲੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
The Lord turned His back on the Khatris and Brahmins and showed His face to Namdev. ॥3॥
ਜਿਤਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕਾ; ਮੁਖਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ. ਤਿਨ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਢਾਇ ॥
All the Lord's devotees and servants have the tilak applied to their foreheads by the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪਰਸੇ; ਜੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
Servant Nanak would touch their feet night and day, if the Lord, the King, would show mercy. ॥4॥1॥8॥
ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ; ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਰਾ ॥
Only those with destiny written on their foreheads from the start have worshipped the Lord within.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
What can anyone do by slandering those whose side my Lord, the Creator, takes? ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ, ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ; ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my mind, meditate on the Lord, O mind, meditate on Him; He is the destroyer of the pains of birth after birth. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਬਖਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
From the start the Lord blessed His devotees with the treasure of amrit devotion.
ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Only a fool tries to rival them; his face is blackened here and hereafter. ॥2॥
ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕਾ; ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
They alone are devotees and servants who love the Lord's Name.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਿਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਪਵੈ ਛਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Through serving them the Lord is found, and ashes fall on the head of the slanderer. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਿਰਤੀ. ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ; ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਛਿ, ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Only the one in whose heart it happens knows it; ask Guru Nanak, the Guru of the world, and reflect.
ਚਹੁ ਪੀੜੀ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ, ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
Through the four generations, from the very beginning, no one has found anything by envy; one is carried across only by the spirit of service. ॥4॥2॥9॥
ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Wherever the Lord is worshipped, there the Lord comes as friend and helper.
734: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹੋਰਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਇਆ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
By the Guru's grace the Lord dwells in the mind; He cannot be found by any other means. ॥1॥
O brother, gather the wealth of the Lord's Name,
ਜਿ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so that the Lord may be your friend here and hereafter. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀਐ; ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ, ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
The wealth of the Lord is earned in the true congregation; it is not found anywhere else, by any other means.
ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੈ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ, ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ; ਕਚੈ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ. ਵਾਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਲਇਆ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
The dealer in the Lord's jewel buys the jewel of the Lord's wealth; by the advice of dealers in glass it cannot be had. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ. ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ, ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਵਤੈ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ. ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
The Lord's wealth is a jewel, a gem, a ruby; at the ambrosial hour of dawn the devotees attune themselves to it in devotion.
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਵਤੈ ਕਾ ਬੀਜਿਆ; ਭਗਤ; ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ, ਨਿਖੁਟੈ, ਨਾਹੀ ॥ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
Sown in the season of the ambrosial hour, the Lord's wealth is used and shared by the devotees, yet never runs out; here and hereafter they are honoured for it. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ, ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ; ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਤਸਕਰੈ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਜਮਦੂਤੈ; ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
The Lord's wealth is free of fear, eternal and true; fire, thieves, water and the messengers of Death cannot destroy it.
ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਉਚਕਾ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਡੰਡੁ. ਨ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੪॥
No robber comes near it, and Death the tax-collector cannot levy duty on it. ॥4॥
ਸਾਕਤੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ, ਬਿਖਿਆ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ; ਤਿਨਾ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਨਾਲਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
The faithless gather the wealth of Maya by committing sins, yet it does not go a single step with them.
ਹਲਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ. ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਏ, ਹਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕਿ ਗਇਆ; ਅਗੈ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਾਕਤੁ, ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
In this world they are miserable, and it slips from their hands; hereafter they find no shelter in the Lord's court. ॥5॥
ਇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਸਾਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ. ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਲਦਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
O saints, the Lord Himself is the banker of this wealth; the one to whom He gives it loads it and departs.
ਇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਕਾ ਤੋਟਾ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥੩॥੧੦॥
This wealth never runs short; the Guru has given this understanding to servant Nanak. ॥6॥3॥10॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਹੋਇ, ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਰਵੈ; ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
The one with whom the Lord is well pleased sings His praises; that one is a devotee, accepted by Him.
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਵਰਨੀਐ; ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
How can the glory be described of the one in whose heart the Lord, the Supreme Being, dwells? ॥1॥
ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਜੀਉ; ਲਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Let us sing the praises of the Lord of the Universe, with our attention fixed on the True Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ. ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Such is the True Guru, and service to him is fruitful, from whom the supreme treasure is obtained.
ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਅਰਥਿ. ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ; ਸੋ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
The faithless who, in love of duality and for the sake of desire, serve foul vices waste their lives in utter ignorance. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ; ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
The singing of the one who has faith is accepted, and that one is honoured in the Lord's court.
ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਤੀਤੀ. ਕਪਟੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਦੇ; ਉਨ ਕਾ ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Those deceivers without faith who close their eyes in pretence will have their false pride stripped away. ॥3॥
ਜੇਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
All soul and body are Yours; You are the Knower of hearts, the all-pervading Lord.
ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ. ਤੇਹਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਵਖਿਆਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
Servant Nanak, slave of Your slaves, says: as You make me speak, so I speak. ॥4॥4॥11॥
735: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਤੇਰੇ ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਣ. ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਗਾਵਾ; ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Which of Your virtues can I name and sing? You are the Master, the treasure of virtues.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ; ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਊਚ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
I cannot describe Your greatness; You are the Lord, the lofty God. ॥1॥
ਮੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
The Lord's Name alone is my support.
ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ; ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Save me as it pleases You, my Master; apart from You I have no other. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮੈ. ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਮੈ. ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
You alone are my strength and my refuge, my Master; I pray only before You.
ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ. ਜਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
I have no other place where I can plead; I bring my pain and my joy to You alone. ॥2॥
ਵਿਚੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਪਾਣੀ; ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
Earth is held within water and water within earth, and fire is held within wood.
ਬਕਰੀ ਸਿੰਘੁ. ਇਕਤੈ ਥਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ; ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
The goat and the lion are kept in one place; O mind, meditate on the Lord and dispel your doubt and fear. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ਦੇਵਾਏ ॥
Behold the Lord's greatness, O saints: the Lord gives honour to the dishonoured.
ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਤਲੇ ਤੇ. ਊਪਰਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਆਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
Nanak: as the earth beneath one's feet comes over one at death, so the Lord brings the whole world to fall at the feet of the holy. ॥4॥1॥12॥
ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
You are the Creator and know everything Yourself; what can be told to You?
ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ. ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ; ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
You know all the bad and good; as one does, so one receives. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ; ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
O my Master, You know the state within.
ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ; ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You know all the bad and good; as it pleases You, so You make us speak. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ, ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ; ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਨੁਖ. ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
The Lord made all attachment to Maya and every body; within the human body He Himself inspires devotion.
ਇਕਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ; ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈ ॥੨॥
Some You unite with the True Guru and bless with peace; the self-willed He keeps entangled in worldly affairs. ॥2॥
ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ; ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
All belong to You, and You are Master of all, my Creator; You have written the destiny on every head.
ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਦਰੀ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
As You cast Your glance, so one becomes; without Your glance no one becomes anything. ॥3॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ. ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਸਭ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Only You know Your greatness; all meditate on You always.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
Whomever You please, You unite with Yourself; servant Nanak, that one is accepted. ॥4॥2॥13॥
ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ. ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Those within whom my Lord dwells are rid of all their illnesses.
ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ. ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਤਿਨ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Those who have meditated on the Lord's Name are liberated, and attain the pure, supreme state. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਆਰੋਗ ਭਏ ॥
O my Lord, the Lord's servants have become healthy.
ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ; ਹਰਿ; ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who chanted my Lord's Name through the Guru's word are rid of the disease of ego. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਗੀ; ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva were afflicted by the three qualities, acting in ego.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ. ਤਿਸਹਿ, ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
The poor wretches did not remember the One who made them; understanding of the Lord comes through the Guru. ॥2॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
The whole world is gripped by the disease of ego, and suffers the heavy pain of birth and death.
736: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਛੂਟੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
By the Guru's grace a rare one is freed; I am a sacrifice to that person. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ. ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
The One who created the world alone knows it; His form is infinite.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
Nanak: the Lord Himself beholds it and is delighted; through the Guru one reflects on God. ॥4॥3॥14॥
ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਜਾਈ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਚੈ. ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੀਐ ॥
Whatever is made and done is done by the Lord of the Will; we would do something if we could.
ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ. ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੀਐ ॥੧॥
Nothing happens by our own doing; as it pleases the Lord, so He keeps us. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ॥
O my dear Lord, everyone is in Your power.
ਅਸਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਸਾਕਹ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬਖਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
We have no strength to do anything ourselves; as it pleases You, forgive us. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ; ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
You Yourself gave all soul and body, and You Yourself set each to its task.
ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ. ਤੇਹੇ ਕੋ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਜੇਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
As You command, so one acts, according to what You wrote from the start. ॥2॥
ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ. ਤੁਧੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ; ਕੋਈ ਛੇਵਾ ਕਰਿਉ. ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Making the five elements, You created the whole world; let anyone make a sixth, if they can do anything.
ਇਕਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ. ਤੂੰ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ; ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
Some You unite with the True Guru and give understanding; others, self-willed, do as they please and weep. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ. ਹਉ ਆਖਿ, ਨ ਸਾਕਾ; ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਨੀਚਾਣੁ ॥
I cannot describe the Lord's greatness; I am foolish, ignorant and lowly.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪਇਆ ਅਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
O Lord, my Master, forgive servant Nanak; this ignorant one has fallen into Your refuge. ॥4॥4॥15॥24॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
As a juggler stages his show,
and when he takes off his costume and ends the play,
then there is only the One, the One Creator. ॥1॥
ਕਤਹਿ ਗਇਓ; ਉਹੁ ਕਤ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Where has the being gone, and where did it come from? ॥1॥ Rahao
From gold, ornaments of many kinds are made.
Sowing a seed, one sees many forms.
When the fruit ripens, it is the One again. ॥2॥
One sky appears in thousands of pitchers.
When the pitchers break, only that sky remains.
Doubt, greed, attachment and the vices arise from the illusion of Maya.
When doubt is dispelled, there is only the One Creator. ॥3॥
He is imperishable; He never perishes.
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
No one truly comes and no one goes.
The Perfect Guru has washed away the filth of my ego.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਮੇਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Says Nanak: I have attained the supreme state. ॥4॥1॥
O God, whatever You wish to do comes to pass.
Apart from You there is no other.
ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
The servant who serves You has all tasks fulfilled.
You save the honour of Your servant. ॥1॥
I seek Your refuge, O perfectly merciful Lord.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Apart from You, who can sustain us? ॥1॥ Rahao
He pervades water, land and sky.
God dwells near; He is not far away.
By pleasing people, nothing is obtained.
When one is attached to the True One, ego departs. ॥2॥
737: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ; ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Only the one whom He attaches is attached to Him.
The jewel of spiritual wisdom awakens within that one.
Evil-mindedness departs and the supreme state is attained.
By the Guru's grace that one meditates on the Name. ॥3॥
With palms joined I offer my prayer.
If it pleases You, You bring it to fruition.
The one whom God in His mercy attaches to His devotion,
servant Nanak, meditates on God for ever. ॥4॥2॥
Blessed is the happy bride who recognises God,
who obeys His command and gives up her pride.
Dyed in her Beloved's love, she enjoys His union. ॥1॥
Listen, O companion, to the sign of meeting God:
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ; ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
give up concern for what people think, and offer Him your mind and body. ॥1॥ Rahao
the one who does only what pleases God,
that happy bride merges in His embrace. ॥2॥
The one in the grip of pride does not find His palace.
She repents when the night of life has passed.
The unfortunate, self-willed bride suffers pain. ॥3॥
I would pray to Him if I thought He were far away,
but the imperishable Lord pervades everywhere.
Servant Nanak sings His praises, seeing Him ever present. ॥4॥3॥
ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਵਸਿ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨਾ; ਹਉ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Through the Guru, my Husband brought the house of my body under my control; I am the mistress of the home.
He has made the ten senses my handmaidens.
ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ; ਮੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋੜੀ ॥
I have gathered and arranged all the furnishings of virtue in my home.
Filled with hope and thirst, I long for my Husband. ॥1॥
Which of the virtues of my beloved Husband can I describe?
He is wise, beautiful and merciful, the Destroyer of pride. ॥1॥ Rahao
I have made truthful conduct my adornment, and applied the collyrium of His fear to my eyes.
I have chewed the betel leaf of the amrit Name.
Bracelets, robes and ornaments look beautiful on her,
ਧਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ; ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
and the bride finds every comfort when her Husband comes home. ॥2॥
Making virtues her charms, she has won over her Husband.
ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
The Guru dispelled her doubt, and she brought Him under her sway.
My mansion is the highest of all.
ਸਭ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ; ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Leaving all other brides, my Beloved has become mine. ॥3॥
The sun has risen and its light shines forth.
I have spread the bed of boundless faith.
ਨਵ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲੁ; ਸੇਜ ਰਾਵਣ ਆਇਆ ॥
My Beloved, ever fresh in love, has come to enjoy the bed.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਮਿਲਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
Servant Nanak: meeting her Husband, the bride has found peace. ॥4॥4॥
My heart leapt with joy to meet God.
I set out searching, to see the place where my Beloved lives.
ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
Hearing my Beloved's message, I spread the bed in my home.
ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ; ਤਉ ਨਦਰਿ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
But I wandered and wandered and came back, and still did not receive His glance. ॥1॥
How can this humble heart be comforted?
ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਜਨ; ਹਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meet me, O Friend; I am a sacrifice to You. ॥1॥ Rahao
One bed is spread for the bride and her Husband.
The bride is asleep, while the Husband is ever awake.
The bride is drunk, as if she had drunk wine.
The bride awakens only if her Husband calls her. ॥2॥
Many days have passed, and I have grown hopeless.
I have searched through all the lands abroad.
738: ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵਉ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਗ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
Without falling at His feet I find no peace even for an instant.
If God becomes merciful, we fortunate ones will meet Him. ॥3॥
He became merciful and united me with the true congregation.
The burning is quenched; I have found my Husband in my own home.
Now all my adornments look beautiful to me.
Says Nanak: the Guru has dispelled my doubt. ॥4॥
ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ; ਤਹ ਪਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
Wherever I look, there is my Husband, O brother.
ਖੋਲੑਿਓ ਕਪਾਟੁ; ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੫॥
When the door was opened, my mind became steady. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥5॥
ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ. ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੀ; ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
Which of Your virtues can I remember and cherish, O Giver to me who am without virtue?
ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ; ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
What cleverness can a bought slave show? This soul and body are all Yours. ॥1॥
ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ; ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O beloved, playful Lord, Enticer of the mind, I am a sacrifice to Your vision. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ. ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ; ਤੁਮੑ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
God is the Giver and I am a poor beggar; You are ever and ever kind.
ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਜਿ ਮੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
There is nothing I can do by myself, O my unreachable, infinite Master. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਉ. ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ; ਬਿਧਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ ॥
What service can I perform, what can I say to please You, by what means can I have Your vision?
ਮਿਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ, ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਲਹੀਐ; ਮਨੁ ਤਰਸੈ ਚਰਨਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Your measure cannot be found nor Your limit known; my mind longs for Your feet. ॥3॥
ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ. ਢੀਠੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਗਉ; ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਰੇ ॥
Shamelessly I beg for this gift: that the dust of the saints' feet may touch my forehead.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
Servant Nanak: on whom the Guru showed grace, God gave His hand and carried across. ॥4॥6॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The service is little, but the demands are great.
He has not reached the palace, yet says he has arrived. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮਾਨੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੀਸਾ ॥
He competes with those whom the Beloved has honoured.
Such is the stubbornness of the false fool. ॥1॥ Rahao
He displays religious robes but does not practise the Truth.
He says he has reached the palace, yet does not even come near. ॥2॥
He calls himself detached, yet is drunk on Maya.
ਮਨਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਕਹੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
There is no love in his mind, yet he says he is dyed in it. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: O God, hear my prayer.
I am sinful, hard-hearted and lustful; set me free. ॥4॥
Grant us the glory of beholding Your vision.
ਤੁਮੑ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ; ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੭॥
You are the Giver of peace, the loving Lord. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥1॥7॥
For evil deeds he gets up early;
ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ; ਪੈ ਪੈ ਸੋਇਆ ॥੧॥
but when it is time for the Name, he lies down and sleeps. ॥1॥
The ignorant one does not understand his opportunity;
he is entangled in the love of Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਕਉ; ਬਿਗਸਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
He swells with delight on the waves of greed,
ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ; ਨ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
but does not seek the vision of the holy. ॥2॥
again and again he is entangled in worldly affairs. ॥1॥ Rahao
He is drenched in delight hearing songs of sin with his ears,
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ; ਆਲਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
but is lazy in mind when it comes to hearing the Lord's praise. ॥3॥
O blind man, do you not see with your eyes
ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ; ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that you will leave all these false affairs and depart? ॥1॥ Rahao
Says Nanak: O God, forgive me.
739: In Your mercy, grant me the company of the holy. ॥4॥
ਤਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਉ ਹੋਈਐ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
One gains something only by becoming the dust of their feet.
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨॥੮॥
The one whom He gives this understanding chants the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥2॥8॥
ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਨਦਰਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
The faithless one does not see the Lord in the home of the heart,
yet hangs a stone idol around his neck. ॥1॥
Deluded by doubt, the faithless one wanders about.
ਨੀਰੁ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ; ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮਰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He churns water and wastes away in spiritual death. ॥1॥ Rahao
The stone he calls his Lord
ਓਹੁ ਪਾਹਣੁ; ਲੈ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਡੁਬਤਾ ॥੨॥
drags him down with it and drowns. ॥2॥
O sinner, ungrateful to your salt,
a boat of stone cannot carry you across. ॥3॥
Nanak: the one who has come to know the Lord by meeting the Guru
sees the perfect Creator pervading water, land and sky. ॥4॥3॥9॥
By what means have you enjoyed your Beloved?
O companion, tell me that wisdom too. ॥1॥
Crimson, crimson, crimson is your face,
ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
dyed in the love of your Beloved. ॥1॥ Rahao
I would wash your feet with the pupils of my eyes,
and go wherever you send me. ॥2॥
ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ; ਦੇਉ ਜਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
I would give away all my chanting, austerity and self-discipline,
ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ; ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
if you would unite me with the Master of my life for even an instant. ॥3॥
The one who has destroyed pride, self-reliance and egoistic intellect,
Nanak, she is the happily wedded bride. ॥4॥4॥10॥
You are my life, the support of my breath.
ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ; ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Beholding You alone, my mind is comforted. ॥1॥
You are my Friend, You are my Beloved.
ਚਿਤਹਿ. ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ; ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
May You never be forgotten from my mind at any time. ॥1॥ Rahao
I am Your humble slave, bought and paid for.
You are my great Master, profound and full of virtues. ॥2॥
Millions of servants stand at His court,
and He dwells with them every moment. ॥3॥
ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
I am nothing; everything is Yours.
Nanak: like warp and weft You dwell with me. ॥4॥5॥11॥
ਸੂਖ ਮਹਲ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਊਚ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
The Lord whose mansions are full of bliss and whose gates are lofty:
in them dwell His beloved devotees. ॥1॥
ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
The sermon of God that brings poise is utterly sweet.
Only a rare one has seen it with their eyes. ॥1॥ Rahao
There are songs and melodies, and arenas of the spiritual struggle.
There the saints celebrate the Lord's love. ॥2॥
ਤਹ. ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣੁ; ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਹਰਖਾ ॥
There is no death or birth there, no sorrow or joy.
The amrit of the True Name rains down. ॥3॥
ਗੁਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਇਹ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Nanak learned this secret sermon from the Guru;
so Nanak utters the Bani of the Lord. ॥4॥6॥12॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ; ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
Those by whose vision millions of sins are washed away,
and meeting whom one is carried across this world-ocean, ॥1॥
they are my companions, they are my beloved friends,
ਜੋ ਹਮ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who remind me of the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਤ; ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
Hearing their word, all comforts are obtained.
Serving them, the messengers of Death are driven away. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਕ; ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥
Remembering the Name they give, one's face becomes radiant. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
God Himself has adorned the lives of His servants.
Nanak: seek their refuge, and be ever a sacrifice to them. ॥4॥7॥13॥
740: ਰਹਣੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Angelic beings and gods cannot stay here for ever.
ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ; ਕਰਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
The silent sages and those who served them have all risen and departed. ॥1॥
ਜੀਵਤ ਪੇਖੇ; ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Only those who have meditated on the Lord are seen to be truly alive.
In the holy congregation they have received His vision. ॥1॥ Rahao
Kings, emperors, bankers and traders must die.
Whatever is seen will be taken by Death. ॥2॥
One stays entangled in false attachment,
and when one must leave it all and depart, then one repents. ॥3॥
ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
O treasure of mercy, give Nanak this gift:
that I may chant Your Name day and night. ॥4॥8॥14॥
You dwell within each and every heart.
All things are strung on Your thread. ॥1॥
You are my Beloved, You are the support of my breath.
ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ; ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Beholding You again and again, my mind blossoms. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Wandering through countless births, beings grow weary.
Now they have taken the support of the holy congregation. ॥2॥
He is unreachable, beyond the senses, unknowable and infinite;
Nanak remembers Him day and night. ॥3॥9॥15॥
Of what use is greatness that comes from Maya,
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਤ; ਬਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
which perishes in no time at all? ॥1॥
This world is a dream, but the sleeper does not know it.
In his unconscious state he clings to it. ॥1॥ Rahao
The fool is bewitched by great attachment,
and while he looks on, he rises and departs. ॥2॥
ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
The highest of the high is His court.
He destroys and creates countless beings. ॥3॥
There has been no other like Him, nor will there ever be.
Nanak: chant the Name of that One God. ॥4॥10॥16॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Remembering Him again and again, I live.
ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਤੇਰੇ; ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
O Lord, I wash Your lotus feet and drink the water. ॥1॥
That Lord of mine is the Knower of hearts.
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ. ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Master dwells with His devotees. ॥1॥ Rahao
Hearing again and again of Your amrit Name, I meditate on it.
Twenty-four hours a day I sing Your praises. ॥2॥
Beholding Your play, my mind is in bliss.
O God of supreme bliss, Your virtues are infinite. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਕਛੁ ਭਉ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Remembering Him, no fear can touch one;
Nanak, chant the Lord's Name for ever and ever. ॥4॥11॥17॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Through the Guru's Word I fix my meditation on the Lord in my heart,
and with my tongue I chant the Name of the Lord of the world. ॥1॥
The Guru's form brings life's fruit; I am a sacrifice to his vision.
ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ; ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
His lotus feet are the support of my mind and breath. ॥1॥ Rahao
In the company of the holy I have ended birth and death,
and hearing the amrit sermon with my ears I make it my support. ॥2॥
I have given up lust, anger, greed and attachment.
Firm faith in the Name, service and pure conduct have become my good way of life. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: reflect on this essence,
and chanting the Lord's Name, carry yourself across. ॥4॥12॥18॥
We sinners are absorbed in greed and attachment.
